name: Auth.js (NextAuth)
solves: Provides open-source authentication for web apps (Auth.js / NextAuth.js) with built-in OAuth providers, credentials, email magic links, JWT/database sessions, and first-class Next.js App Router and Pages Router adapters — without requiring a hosted identity vendor.
best_for: Next.js apps that want free, self-hosted auth with dozens of OAuth providers and no per-MAU identity bill
Teams that need JWT or database sessions with adapters for Prisma, Drizzle, or popular SQL/NoSQL stores
Projects migrating off DIY JWT/cookie auth toward a maintained, community-standard auth library
Full-stack apps that want credentials, magic-link email, and social login behind one Auth.js configuration
Open-source or budget-constrained products that cannot adopt Clerk/Auth0 pricing
skip_when: You want polished pre-built hosted UI components and managed user admin without building your own screens
You need enterprise SSO, SCIM, or organization/RBAC as a managed product rather than DIY on top of Auth.js
You prefer a fully managed identity platform (Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS) with SLAs and no session-store ops
Your stack is Python/Go-only with no JavaScript runtime for Auth.js
You only need a thin session cookie encryptor and do not want a full auth framework

hosted_alternative.name: Clerk
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for small apps; paid plans scale with monthly active users and organizations
